grammar.q: The investigators collected [ ____ ] evidence suggesting that the advertisement had been deliberately designed to mislead elderly customers.
[ ____ ] who had tried the product before seeing the ad were far less impressed by its claims than first-time buyers.
The spread of online advertising has created [ ____ ] more pressure on small retailers competing for attention.
Of the three slogans tested, one was rejected immediately, and [ ____ ] were sent back for revision.
The new subscription service has made canceling a membership [ ____ ] complicated for most of its customers, who now have to go through several steps to leave.
After weeks of testing, the company found the new bottle design [ ____ ] to its major retailers.
The hearing of dogs is far more sensitive than [ ____ ] of humans, especially to high-pitched sounds.
Young parrots that have just left the nest must quickly learn to feed [ ____ ] without any help from their parents.
Very [ ____ ] of the shoppers interviewed outside the mall could remember the brand that had sponsored such a prominent event.
The new training center was built [ ____ ] to the park where most owners walk their dogs.
Before the audition, the young singers were advised to familiarize [ ____ ] with the acoustics of the hall.
The calls of young birds in noisy cities are noticeably higher in frequency than [ ____ ] of birds in quiet forests, presumably so that they remain audible over the traffic.
Many viewers considered the commercial [ ____ ] because it repeated the slogan of an older advertisement almost word for word.
The injured dog recovered [ ____ ] quickly after the surgery, surprising even the veterinarian who had predicted that it would need months of painful rehabilitation before it could walk again.
Before launching the campaign, the agency spent weeks gathering [ ____ ] that consumers actually trusted reviews written by ordinary users more than ads endorsed by celebrities.
The pet store gives first-time owners [ ____ ] on choosing food that suits the age of their dogs.
[ ____ ] of the volunteers at the animal shelter stayed late to reassure the dogs frightened by the thunderstorm.
The new brand received [ ____ ] attention from the media in its first year, so its founders had to rely almost entirely on word of mouth.
The hikers who were caught in the sudden snowstorm managed to keep [ ____ ] warm by huddling together with their sled dogs until a rescue team reached them the next morning.
The conductor asked the musicians to imagine [ ____ ] in the position of an audience hearing the symphony for the very first time.
The professor encouraged the students to contact [ ____ ] directly if they had any questions about the survey on consumer preferences.
The river, which flows through five countries, has lost much of [ ____ ] fish population because of pollution.
The body temperature of a hibernating bat is considerably lower than [ ____ ] of an active one hunting insects on a summer night.
The demands placed on professional musicians today are far more complex than [ ____ ] of performers a century ago, when recordings were rare and audiences seldom compared one concert with another.
The twin puppies went to different families; one lives on a farm, and [ ____ ] lives downtown.
Some critics praised the singer’s new album for its bold sound, while [ ____ ] were disappointed that its novelty quickly wore off.
My old headphones broke during the trip, so I bought a new [ ____ ] at the airport.
The cookies that the bakery advertises as “homemade” smell [ ____ ] even from the street outside the shop.
Heavy fog made the mountain road to the dog show extremely [ ____ ] for the trucks carrying the animals.
The researchers examined every comment that consumers had posted about the product [ ____ ] before drawing any conclusions about its credibility.
Spending on online advertising has risen [ ____ ] since smartphones became the main way that most people access the internet.
The rescue team searched [ ____ ] for the missing dog throughout the night, although the falling temperatures made their task even more difficult.
The shy singer had [ ____ ] spoken a word during the rehearsals, so her powerful performance on opening night astonished everyone in the hall.
[ ____ ] , several studies have suggested that singing in a group can alleviate stress in people of all ages.
By the time the sale ended, the store had sold [ ____ ] half of its winter stock.
The old wooden stage was not [ ____ ] to support the weight of the full orchestra, so the concert was moved to the school gym at the last minute.
The trainer noticed [ ____ ] in the dog’s behavior — it barked only when a certain song played on the radio, and it stayed perfectly calm during every other piece of music.
It was [ ____ ] a persuasive advertisement that even shoppers who distrusted the brand admitted they wanted to try the product.
The instructions for the new automatic pet feeder were [ ____ ] poorly written that many customers returned it before they had thoroughly tested it.
The musical equipment donated by the foundation [ ____ ] distributed to rural schools that had few instruments.

arrange.ko: 이번 조사의 결과는 10년 전에 실시된 조사의 결과보다 훨씬 더 믿을 만하다고 여겨진다.
arrange.bogi: than those of the survey conducted ten years ago. / are considered / the results of this survey / far more reliably
arrange.ans: The results of this survey are considered far more reliable than those of the survey conducted ten years ago.

arrange.ko: 일부 생물학자들은 새의 노래가 주로 짝을 끌어들이기 위해 발달했다고 믿는 반면, 다른 학자들은 영역을 지키는 데서의 그 역할을 지적한다.
arrange.bogi: while other point to / some biologists believe / its role in defending territory. / birdsong evolved mainly to attract mates,
arrange.ans: Some biologists believe birdsong evolved mainly to attract mates, while others point to its role in defending territory.

arrange.ko: 그것은 너무 비현실적인 광고 문구여서 그 회사의 직원들조차 그것을 진지하게 받아들이지 않았다.
arrange.bogi: that even the company’s own employees / such an unrealistic slogan / did not take it seriously. / it was
arrange.ans: It was such an unrealistic slogan that even the company’s own employees did not take it seriously.

arrange.ko: 많은 관광객이 ‘숨은 보석’이라고 묘사하는 것은 사실 그 지역 주민들에게는 평범한 시장이다.
arrange.bogi: is actually an ordinary market / what many tourists describe / to local residents. / as a hidden gem
arrange.ans: What many tourists describe as a hidden gem is actually an ordinary market to local residents.

arrange.ko: 개가 주인의 감정을 이해할 수 있다는 생각은 최근의 여러 연구에 의해 뒷받침되어 왔다.
arrange.bogi: their owners’ emotions / the idea / has been supporting by several recent studies. / that dogs can understand
arrange.ans: The idea that dogs can understand their owners’ emotions has been supported by several recent studies.

arrange.ko: 그 실험 결과에 실망하여, 연구팀은 처음부터 다시 시작하기로 결정했다.
arrange.bogi: start again from the beginning. / disappoint by the results of the experiment, / the research team / decided to
arrange.ans: Disappointed by the results of the experiment, the research team decided to start again from the beginning.

arrange.ko: 우리가 나가 있는 동안 강아지가 거실의 모든 쿠션을 뜯어 놓은 것 같다.
arrange.bogi: every cushion in the living room / while we were out. / it looks like / the puppy tear apart
arrange.ans: It looks like the puppy tore apart every cushion in the living room while we were out.

arrange.ko: 광고주들은 그런 주장이 대부분의 소비자에게 불신을 일으킨다는 것을 알면서도 과장된 주장을 계속 사용한다.
arrange.bogi: use exaggerated claims / advertisers / keep / even though they know such claims cause disbelief in most consumers.
arrange.ans: Advertisers keep using exaggerated claims even though they know such claims cause disbelief in most consumers.

arrange.ko: 함께 노래하는 사람들은 혼자 노래하는 사람들보다 서로에게 더 가깝다고 느끼는 경향이 있다.
arrange.bogi: than those who sing alone. / tend to feel close / people who sing together / to one another
arrange.ans: People who sing together tend to feel closer to one another than those who sing alone.

arrange.ko: 공원에서 수십 마리의 개를 보자, Mickey는 처음 몇 분 동안 Tim 곁에 바짝 붙어 있었다.
arrange.bogi: for the first few minutes. / see dozens of dogs at the park, / Mickey / stayed close to Tim
arrange.ans: Seeing dozens of dogs at the park, Mickey stayed close to Tim for the first few minutes.

arrange.ko: 그 브랜드에 대한 태도를 바꾼 소비자들 중 몇몇은 그 제품을 친구들에게도 추천했다.
arrange.bogi: also recommended / a few of the consumers / the product to their friends. / who changed their attitudes toward the brand
arrange.ans: A few of the consumers who changed their attitudes toward the brand also recommended the product to their friends.

translate.en: Dunbar’s hypothesis is based on the observation that, similar to manual grooming, human language plays a key role in building and maintaining affiliative bonds and group cohesion.
translate.ko: Dunbar의 가설은, 손으로 하는 그루밍과 유사하게, 인간의 언어가 친화적 유대와 집단의 결합을 형성하고 유지하는 데 중요한 역할을 한다는 관찰에 근거한다. / NEW 제품이 비싸기 때문에 좋을 것이 틀림없다는 믿음은 흔히 쇼핑객들을 잘못 이끈다.

translate.en: Being sure to follow Jack’s advice, Tim took Mickey for a walk every day.
translate.ko: Jack의 조언을 확실히 따르며, Tim은 Mickey를 매일 산책시켰다. / NEW 투어에 저축한 돈 대부분을 써 버려서, 그 젊은 가수는 시간제 일자리를 구해야 했다.

translate.en: In his study, a sample of housewives was exposed to advertisements for food products and then divided into two groups: those participants that found the ad claims to be believable and the others that thought they were hard to believe.
translate.ko: 그의 연구에서 표본으로 선정된 주부들은 식품 광고에 노출된 다음, 두 집단, 즉 광고의 주장을 믿을 만하다고 여긴 참가자들과 그것을 믿기 어렵다고 생각한 나머지 참가자들로 나뉘었다.

translate.en: The latter group was further divided into two groups, those who confidently disbelieved the claims and those who had what Maloney described as a curious nonbelief.
translate.ko: 후자의 집단은 더 나아가 두 집단, 즉 확신을 갖고 그 주장을 불신한 사람들과 Maloney가 ‘호기심 어린 불신’이라고 묘사한 것을 지닌 사람들로 나뉘었다.

translate.en: Few consumers who clearly disbelieved the message were interested in trying the product (18%).
translate.ko: 메시지를 분명히 불신했던 소비자 중 제품을 사용해 보는 데 관심이 있었던 사람은 거의 없었다(18퍼센트).

translate.en: However, Maloney’s results showed that more consumers who were in the curious nonbelief group were ready to try the product (44%) than in the group that expressed no concerns about (i.e., believed) the advertising claims (34%).
translate.ko: 그러나 Maloney의 결과는 호기심 어린 불신 집단에 있던 소비자들이 그 광고 주장에 대해 아무런 우려를 표하지 않은(즉, 그것을 믿은) 집단보다(34퍼센트) 더 많이(44퍼센트) 제품을 써 볼 준비가 되어 있었다는 것을 보여 주었다.

translate.en: Convincing consumers that the claims about a new product are true is not necessary to create interest in product trial.
translate.ko: 제품을 사용해 보는 데 관심을 갖게 하기 위해 신제품에 관한 주장이 사실이라고 소비자들을 납득시킬 필요는 없다.
